summary: Converts CHOP channel samples into POP points and attributes. Each CHOP sample can become one POP point, with manual channel-to-attribute mapping or automatic conversion using precise naming rules.

key_params.name: surftype
key_params.note: Connectivity for generated points: none, point primitives, line strip, or lines

key_params.name: specifypos
key_params.note: Generate P from start/end position parameters

key_params.name: chanssel
key_params.note: Specify channels or autoconvert precise names

key_concepts: vector and array attribute channel naming
generated P position from CHOP or start/end positions
point primitives, line strips, lines, or no primitives
common_gotchas: Built-in attributes like P, N, Color, and Tex are treated as multi-component attributes.
Precise-name conversion preserves capitalization and uses suffixes for vector and array components.
When point count is overridden, interpolation settings change how CHOP samples become POP points.
